mainEntity.name: Can I install wall insulation myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While some basic insulation tasks, like adding batt insulation in an easily accessible attic, can be DIY, wall insulation often requires professional expertise. Properly insulating walls, especially existing ones, involves specialized equipment for blowing in loose-fill insulation or applying spray foam. Professionals ensure correct R-values, proper air sealing, and adherence to safety protocols, especially when dealing with hazardous materials or tight spaces. Improper installation can lead to moisture issues, reduced effectiveness, or safety risks, making professional installation a worthwhile investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wall insulation, especially for existing homes or spray foam, is best left to professionals. They have specialized equipment, ensure proper R-value, and handle safety.
